name: kb-whisper-small
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from openai/whisper-small (config.json max_position_embeddings 1500). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-25. A finetune of openai/whisper-small, not a new base model: same config.json, same 0.282 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2025-02-14. Caveats: WER table is shared across the whole kb-whisper family, so the "OpenAI" row is the same-size whisper-small baseline, in the same table, per size block - that is a genuine base comparison. Swedish only; card also tags ctranslate2 conversions that live in sibling repos.
